Reshape the `images` helper ([#13](DOT-13.md)) the way [#233](DOT-232.md) proposes for volumes: one `image` command with explicit verbs instead of the positional `images [all|clean|pull]` switch — listing, pruning dangling images, pulling newer tags for every local image.
